objectives.description: Pick up the crackling walkie-talkie.
Take the service pistol and learn to defend yourself.
Inspect the ledger to learn what happened to you.
Read the Dark Tome to discover the Resurrection Rule.
Find the Settlement Gate Key and unlock the exit.
Arm yourself with the bloodied baseball bat.
Find the Butcher's shipment evidence.
Defeat The Butcher in the slaughterhouse.
Take the Bunker Keycard and reach the bunker hatch.
Disable the laser/shock traps using both facility switches (0/2).
Recover the encrypted betrayal dossier.
Collect the Bunker Service Rifle before confronting the Strategist.
Confront and defeat The Strategist.
Unlock the subterranean rift door.
Discover the loophole in the resurrection pact.
Activate all 3 Soul Anchors in the distorted void.
Step through the living-world portal.
Examine your dead friend's memory fragment.
Uncover the final betrayal confession.
Defeat The Betrayer to end the pact.
Walk into the dawn sanctuary to complete your revenge.
